body.text: Run start 2026-11-18T09:36:23Z (authoritative status). This independent run uses the provided reconstruction unchanged; Stage 1 requires no 60-minute wait in this provided-reconstruction case. Method: one deployable history-conditioned neural policy trained from random weights with PPO, demonstration only in rewards. Budget: initial 2h feasibility and parity, 9h PPO curricula, 2h gates and diagnosis, 1h final evidence.

components.name: camera
components.method: MoGe prior + known-geometry PnP profiles, background rotation and stationary-object camera anchors
components.note: Refined camera excludes partial-mask depth hump, max translation2.54cm. Focal regularized1050px; monocular sensitivity retained.

components.name: objects_6d
components.method: Blender geometry, SAM3/SAM2 and physically constrained render-and-compare
components.note: Watertight Blender models with white blade holes and correct socket forms; supported and physically airborne object motion, full-scene replayIoU .8774/.8069. Hidden poses invalid;10mm carry clearance inferred, absolute depth uncertain.

components.name: hand_motion
components.method: HaWoR plus mandatory MANO optimizer owned copy, all778 vertices, anatomical opposed contact and geometry-derived separation; independent installed validators
components.note: 360valid,handmaskIoU.8514; all10required checks pass; full-surface opposed-contact and support-halfspace refits, extra table check max0.426mm. Baseline and every non-default setting retained.

reprojection.note: against your own masks: agreement with them is necessary, not sufficient (3D errors along the viewing ray are invisible here)

anatomical_contact.note: a grasp needs the thumb and an opposing finger on opposite sides of the object; single-finger pushes or palm support are legitimate but must be stated in the analysis. Low penetration does not imply contact.

penetration_hand_object.note: unsigned (lower bound) distances where the object mesh is not watertight

self_penetration.note: triangle intersections between different fingers (FCL); counts are not volumes

physics.note: free-flight intervals are given with --flight OBJ=a:b; rest intervals default to object intervals without contact

handedness_scale.note: left/right are the demonstrator's anatomical hands; a hand is never mirrored

camera_focal.note: MoGe intrinsics are a learned prior; the focal should be calibrated against known geometry (camera_calib.py pnp). A large disagreement needs its explanation in NOTES.md (which one is wrong, and why).

body.text: The first kinematic fingertip fit is sub-millimetre to 1.7 mm, but the open-loop physical test missed the pickup: by 6 s the palm was about 25 mm above its requested grasp, and by 10 s its lift stalled. This is a reach/controller failure before active turning. I will test tilted approaches and select by the complete pregrasp/grasp/lift IK path, rather than treating the fingertip fit as a grasp proof.

simulator.physics: MuJoCo 3.17.0 CPU and MuJoCo Warp 3.17.0 / Warp 1.19.0 CUDA
simulator.solver: Newton, elliptic cone, 100 iterations / 50 line search, tolerance 1e-6; multi-CCD enabled; convex meshes

scene.robot: public modified-DH Marvin chain and Wuji hand body-with-soft meshes/limits; payload 0.866kg
scene.objects: given/recon housing and separate blade convex hulls; small USB recesses/blade holes filled by collision hull only; frames exactly body centre, +Z blade tips, +Y blade gap
sources: ChargerLAB direct measurement of similar Apple 20W form factor, https://www.chargerlab.com/review-of-new-apple-20w-charger-for-iphone-15-a2940/
scene.inference: White resemblance does not prove identity; black unknown; masses, inertia, friction and COM are priors.

reference.mapping: d2s_reference load_demo and hand_axes / T_wrist_palm_from_axes; object starts and goal transformed to deployment, speed .35
reference.use: object path, wrist normal and active relative-rotation shaping for PPO; no reference actions or weights

warnings: 38.44 % of the reference palm positions lie outside the palm-origin box ((0.07, 1.2), (-0.8, 0.8), (-0.315, 1.0)) (the controller clips them)

reference.decision: Raw human wrist replay is unreachable and is not a feasible controller. Do not train the actor to replay it. Adapt grasp heading and arm approach, preserve opposed pickup/active turning/carry/release and the quantified wrist style.

arm.implementation: local unmodified equations of reference controller: ordered jump, speed and workspace clamps; 8-iteration weighted differential IK seeded at measured q; per-joint fractional delays and first-order lag; Cartesian compliance derived from published joint K; external torque estimate and canonical stops
arm.limits: published IK joint limits, controller .02m/.075rad per .01s, raw jump .1m/.5rad
arm.left: public parked arm and mirror-hand capsule obstacles
limitations: arm inertias are approximated by floating palm/payload; capsules detect stops but do not exert forces
Cartesian compliance cap 2e4 N/m, 500 Nm/rad; torque estimated from compliance, not full contact wrench
reference IK lacks the station column barrier; workspace is far from the column and contacts stop; no claim that unreachable targets mimic exact station local minima

hand.PD: kp x30, kv xsqrt(30), matches measured response alternative in RIGHT_HAND.md; torque always capped by grip_scale x vendor effort
hand.limits: deployed limits unchanged; targets inside, stop allowance .02 rad
limitations: no finger self-collision or deformable glove; glove friction randomised, geometric thickness not modelled

sensor.evaluation: default PoseSensor per episode, external fresh gate seed; exact visible_fraction with sampled object surfaces and hand/arm capsules, update at every log row including policy-time sample; all object observation fields replay tested
sensor.training: TorchPoseSensorBatch, same defaults and physical occluders; no true poses in actor

initial_conditions.why_start: The physical reset palm is already clear and camera-visible; 1.5s ramp is explicitly simulated with the same start target, avoiding initial lag while preserving deployment reset. Fingers open at thumb .1 rad.
initial_conditions.object_sampler: start_sampler.py: both kinds equiprobable, x U[.42,.54], y U[-.42,-.24], heading U[-pi,pi], broad side 75%, narrow side25%, random support sign, body supported with 0.1mm initial clearance

episode.evaluation: full length unless stop; ordered style plus exact final .5s placement; deterministic CPU package act on float64 observations

validation.CPU_backend: 100 steps, 4 worlds, 9.75s including first force compilation; same model and batched controller; density fields and inverse weights consistently scaled
validation.FK: implementation public MDH; contract checker validates palm/FK in logs; explicit numerical check to follow
validation.parity: CPU/GPU contact-rich outcome parity pending and required before relying on large-scale PPO; no parity claim yet
validation.feasibility: development-only scripts lifted and actively reoriented one broad white plug; not a full task proof, no task-suite gate yet
validation.penetration: not yet summarized; will publish maximum from full feasibility logs

media.note: Kinematic replay is diagnostic and visibly differs from human where IK cannot reach; it is not used as a success rollout.

body.text: Simulation v1 is r0005. Four hold episodes passed exact contract/sensor replay and supported starts. Local whole-sequence feasibility development on seeds 69,107,149,280: all grasp/lift, none pass turn due passive rotation 143–233deg; one has carry/place stages. Actual finger speed during the deliberately slow 6s turn is often below the standard 0.30rad/s passive threshold, and yaw change during carry permits slip. This is a failed skill proof, not success. A formal feasibility gate is queued; no PPO has been trained. After reviewing that gate I plan a faster active turn, a more stable carry and stronger wrist-style criteria where the initial upper-bound-only criteria are too weak. CPU/GPU full-start 128-seed comparison is running before large-scale PPO.
